description: 0.13.17 DARKNUT MINIBOSS FIX08 (DKN01): the normal Darknut of Enemy Spawner only (B_TN 0x000001FF): phase 1 with 600 HP, posture 200 and progressive armour, phases 2/3 with 480 resistance and posture 160/180; FIX08: after a phase-1 Helm Splitter the Darknut looks for Link again (head, then body), phase-1 mace / shield bash posture on Link 24/36, 31/43, 50/60, Link's damage x2 while his posture break runs (was x1.5), occasional native side / back evasions in phases 2-3 (0/10/15/20 % by Link's consecutive swing, 3 s apart, never over a parry), the sword darkens with the body in the definitive death (Darknut only), parry clash pitch kept for the whole contact, no ordinary attack over Link's running swing and only through a neutral stance after a defense, F1-C3 first vertical 36 ticks with its visible lift, the last single cut of F2-C1 returns smoothly to the combat stance; every other enemy unchanged.
